text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: routing-policy-alert triggered for tenant r-42 (high error rate, elevated latencies)

sre-oncall: paging in, I’m on it. what’s the initial scope?

maria-nguyen: seeing a spike in 504s and model fallbacks across eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. customers hitting 200ms -> 1.2s tail lat.

jonas-lee: dump of last 5 tokens: lots of repeated fallback loops where requests keep switching region on retry. looks like routing policy evaluated fallback target as "global" and then later as us-east-1 in a loop.

support-ops: we have 3 active customer tickets reporting degraded chatstreaming (timeouts+partial responses). CS assigned high priority.

sre-oncall: can we confirm recent schema change? any config deploys in last 30 min?

deploy-bot: Deploy 8d3f2a applied to config-service at 1977777420 by product-alex.

product-alex: that deploy included the policy-schema migration (deprecated field removal: `fallback_region` -> new `region_order`). We hoped defaults would be preserved but there was a subtle fallback default.

maria-nguyen: found the culprit: a single-line migration returned null for missing `region_order`, and downstream code treated null as empty => runtime default became [`global`] which routes to a cross-region umbrella variant that is not capacity-limited, creating thrash.

jonas-lee: reproducing locally. config-service returns policy {"primary":"eu-west-1","fallback":null} -> runtime expands to ["global","us-east-1"] due to old compatibility shim.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation options? can we short-circuit to pinned model variant or force local-only routing?

maria-nguyen: pushing a hotfix to config-service to honor old `fallback_region` if present and to set a safe default of same-region only while we audit. preparing patch.

support-ops: customer-impact: 12 tenants showing >30% error increase, two enterprise customers on Dedicated reported SLA alarms. Logging to CS tickets.

sre-oncall: rolling out a runtime-level emergency guard: set env REDWOOD_ROUTING_SAFE_MODE=true which forces per-region-only fallback and disables the global umbrella variant. doing canary to 10% of request traffic now.

jonas-lee: can see canary traffic stabilized within 60s. latency back down to normal for canary subset.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Emergency guard applied (canary 10%). Pager remains active.

maria-nguyen: hotfix deployed to config-service (1977777890). It converts null fallback -> [primary-region] and emits a migration warning in logs.

sre-oncall: increasing canary to 50% now. monitoring metrics.

product-alex: will revert the schema enforcement change in the next release and add explicit migration steps, docs, and a safety test.

support-ops: CS update posted to affected customers: "We have implemented a mitigation to prevent cross-region fallback loops and are rolling a fix; expect degraded behavior to be resolved in the next 30-60 minutes."

jonas-lee: canary 50% stable for 5 minutes. bumping to 100%.

sre-oncall: full rollout done at 1977778210. metrics show errors back to baseline, tail latencies recovered.

customer-success-bot: Notified customers A & B with follow-up details and apology.

incident-bot: :information_source: Post-incident tasks (assigned):
- maria-nguyen: ship schema-migration rollback + add compatibility layer (PR ready).
- jonas-lee: add unit/integration tests for config-service migration behavior and runtime fallback defaults.
- product-alex: update release notes and migration docs; schedule changelog announcement.
- support-ops: run through customer impact list and confirm ticket statuses.

maria-nguyen: file created: I’ll open a follow-up RFC for defaulting behavior and add a canary gate to schema changes.

sre-oncall: root cause summary: schema change removed/deprecated `fallback_region` field without an explicit compatibility path. migration returned null -> runtime defaulted to umbrella/global fallback variant -> cross-region routing oscillation and capacity thrash.

product-alex: estimated customer impact window ~1977777420 -> 1977778210 (~14.5 minutes).

support-ops: two tenants asked for credits; escalating to finance for review.

jonas-lee: logs to attach to postmortem: `routing-eval.log` snippets showing repeated region decisions, sample request ids: rq_0x5a, rq_0x6b, rq_0x7c.

incident-bot: :thumbsup: Incident declared resolved at 1977778215. Please add notes to the incident board and link PRs.

maria-nguyen: will create the postmortem draft and ping leads for review.

sre-oncall: good coordination. takeaways: stricter schema rollout rules, add runtime safe-mode defaults, and add an automated smoke test that validates cross-region fallback behavior on deploy.

product-alex: adding a post-deploy checklist item: verify `region_order` not empty and emits explicit deprecation warnings during migration.

support-ops: closing customer-facing thread after follow-ups.

jonas-lee: adding a permanent alert that monitors repeated route flips for the same request id (threshold: >3 flips in 2 minutes).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions captured. Postmortem owners: maria-nguyen, jonas-lee, product-alex.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone — reassigning on-call to next shift at 1977778420.

support-ops: marking tickets as "mitigated" for now, will reopen if any regression.

maria-nguyen: PRs: config-service#482 (hotfix), runtime#918 (safe-mode). will link in postmortem.

product-alex: adding retro meeting for schema-change process next week.

support-ops: closing thread but keeping incident channel pinned for docs.
